method: GET https://apps.apple.com/<store>/app/id<N> (desktop UA, default page, no l= param), JSON in <script id=serialized-server-data>: Annotation whose items are textPair (leadingText=name, trailingText=price) = the In-App Purchases list (max 10 shown, Apple's selection); plus InAppPurchaseLockup (promoted subscription) when present.
main_rule: per period: items whose NAME names the period (EN + storefront language) and carry no promo modifier (trial/offer/special/price in the name); main = most frequent price among them, tie = first in page order. If no listed item names the period, fall back to a promoted subscription whose offer text states the period. Otherwise null (not read). Items named only 'Premium' (no period) stay as period 'other' and never feed main. 'Quarterly' stays quarterly (not main).
caveats: The page shows at most 10 IAPs and does not say which ones the paywall offers.
Prices are store prices incl. VAT where applicable.
cr and do storefronts price in USD (text 'USD'), converted 1:1.
